words.definitionEn: Holding firmly to something and refusing to give up.
words.scenario: 强调牢牢坚持，不轻易放弃目标或观点

examples.zh: 她是一位锲而不舍的研究者。

words.commonMistakes: 决心明确用 determined；持续不放弃可用 persistent；克服困难坚持用 persevering；牢牢抓住目标用 tenacious；不肯改变看法常用 stubborn。persistent 不必总是褒义。

words.meaningZh: adj. 持续的；坚持不懈的
words.definitionEn: Continuing for a long time or continuing despite difficulty.
words.scenario: 重复或持续存在，可褒可贬

examples.zh: 他接连不断的问题让我烦躁。

words.commonMistakes: 决心明确用 determined；持续不放弃可用 persistent；克服困难坚持用 persevering；牢牢抓住目标用 tenacious；不肯改变看法常用 stubborn。persistent 不必总是褒义。

words.definitionEn: Continuing to work toward a goal despite difficulties.
words.scenario: 强调面对困难仍继续努力，通常褒义

examples.zh: 这位坚持不懈的学生终于成功了。

words.commonMistakes: 决心明确用 determined；持续不放弃可用 persistent；克服困难坚持用 persevering；牢牢抓住目标用 tenacious；不肯改变看法常用 stubborn。persistent 不必总是褒义。

words.meaningZh: adj. 固执的；难以去除的
words.definitionEn: Unwilling to change your mind, or difficult to remove or deal with.
words.scenario: 不肯改变，也可形容顽固污渍或问题
words.commonMistakes: 决心明确用 determined；持续不放弃可用 persistent；克服困难坚持用 persevering；牢牢抓住目标用 tenacious；不肯改变看法常用 stubborn。persistent 不必总是褒义。

words.definitionEn: Firmly decided and strongly committed to doing something.
words.scenario: 目标明确，决意去做
words.commonMistakes: 决心明确用 determined；持续不放弃可用 persistent；克服困难坚持用 persevering；牢牢抓住目标用 tenacious；不肯改变看法常用 stubborn。persistent 不必总是褒义。

words.definitionEn: One of several payments or parts released over time; British spelling.
words.scenario: 英式常见拼写，也指分期连载的一部分
words.commonMistakes: 分期款只是 payment 的一种；deposit 和 loan 不相同。instalment/installment 是拼写变体。deposit 的具体返还规则不能仅从这个英文词判断。

words.definitionEn: One of several payments or parts released over time; American spelling.
words.scenario: 美式常见拼写，与 instalment 同义
words.commonMistakes: 分期款只是 payment 的一种；deposit 和 loan 不相同。instalment/installment 是拼写变体。deposit 的具体返还规则不能仅从这个英文词判断。

words.definitionEn: The act of paying, or an amount of money paid.
words.scenario: 泛指付款动作或一笔款项
words.commonMistakes: 分期款只是 payment 的一种；deposit 和 loan 不相同。instalment/installment 是拼写变体。deposit 的具体返还规则不能仅从这个英文词判断。

words.meaningZh: n./v. 押金；订金；存款；存放
words.definitionEn: Money paid in advance or as security, or money put into a bank; to put something somewhere.
words.scenario: 指先付的保证款或存入的钱，具体用途看语境

examples.en: We paid a deposit on the room.

words.correctUsage: We paid a deposit on the room.
words.commonMistakes: 分期款只是 payment 的一种；deposit 和 loan 不相同。instalment/installment 是拼写变体。deposit 的具体返还规则不能仅从这个英文词判断。

words.definitionEn: Money or something else borrowed temporarily; to lend.
words.scenario: 借入后须归还的款项，也可指借出的物品

examples.en: She took out a loan to buy a car.

words.correctUsage: She took out a loan to buy a car.
words.commonMistakes: 分期款只是 payment 的一种；deposit 和 loan 不相同。instalment/installment 是拼写变体。deposit 的具体返还规则不能仅从这个英文词判断。

words.definitionEn: Direction or position, relevance to something, or a person's manner.
words.scenario: 导航指方位；固定搭配中可指关系或影响

examples.en: The result has a bearing on our decision.
examples.zh: 结果与我们的决定有关。

words.correctUsage: The result has a bearing on our decision.
words.commonMistakes: 泛指朝向用 direction；导航方位可用 bearing。get one's bearings 是熟悉或辨明方位，have a bearing on 却是与某事相关，不能照字面译成方向。

words.definitionEn: The way something moves or points; guidance on what to do.
words.scenario: 泛指朝向；复数常指路线说明或指示

examples.en: We walked in the wrong direction.

words.correctUsage: We walked in the wrong direction.
words.commonMistakes: 泛指朝向用 direction；导航方位可用 bearing。get one's bearings 是熟悉或辨明方位，have a bearing on 却是与某事相关，不能照字面译成方向。

words.definitionEn: To love or like someone or something very much.
words.scenario: 对人或物的强烈喜爱，日常可用

examples.en: I adore spending time with them.
examples.zh: 我非常喜欢和他们相处。

words.correctUsage: I adore spending time with them.
words.commonMistakes: adore 适合表达非常喜欢某人或某物；worship 更有敬拜或把人奉若神明的意味。worship 偶像时可为夸张说法，不必真的涉及宗教仪式。

words.definitionEn: To show religious devotion or very strong admiration.
words.scenario: 核心为宗教敬拜，也可夸张表示极度崇拜
words.commonMistakes: adore 适合表达非常喜欢某人或某物；worship 更有敬拜或把人奉若神明的意味。worship 偶像时可为夸张说法，不必真的涉及宗教仪式。

words.definitionEn: Close to an amount or value, but not exactly.
words.scenario: 较正式的数值估算，不保证特别精确
words.commonMistakes: approximately 与 roughly 作“大约”时常可互换，正式程度不同不等于精确程度固定不同。approximate 是形容词或动词：an approximate number；approximately 是副词：approximately 50 people，不能说 approximate 50 people 来表示“大约50人”。roughly 另有粗略地、粗暴地的意思。

words.meaningZh: adv. 大约；粗略地；粗暴地
words.definitionEn: Approximately; also without precision or with force.
words.scenario: 估算义较日常，另可描述不精细或粗暴动作
words.commonMistakes: approximately 与 roughly 作“大约”时常可互换，正式程度不同不等于精确程度固定不同。approximate 是形容词或动词：an approximate number；approximately 是副词：approximately 50 people，不能说 approximate 50 people 来表示“大约50人”。roughly 另有粗略地、粗暴地的意思。

words.meaningZh: n./v. 货物；货运；运费；货运运输
words.definitionEn: Goods transported in bulk, their transport, or its cost; to transport goods.
words.scenario: 常强调商业运输体系、方式或费用
words.commonMistakes: 强调货运模式和运费时用 freight；强调运载的货物时常用 cargo。两词的货物义有重叠，并非一个只能陆运、一个只能海运。

words.definitionEn: Goods carried by a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle.
words.scenario: 强调正在运输或装载的货物，常见于船机语境

examples.en: The ship carries a cargo of grain.

words.correctUsage: The ship carries a cargo of grain.
words.commonMistakes: 强调货运模式和运费时用 freight；强调运载的货物时常用 cargo。两词的货物义有重叠，并非一个只能陆运、一个只能海运。

words.definitionEn: A space built into a room where a fire can burn, usually connected to a chimney.
words.scenario: 通常指房间墙内或墙边用于生火取暖的空间，传统壁炉连接烟囱

examples.en: We sat by the fireplace on a cold evening.
examples.zh: 在一个寒冷的晚上，我们坐在壁炉旁。

words.correctUsage: We sat by the fireplace on a cold evening.
words.commonMistakes: fireplace 是壁炉或生火取暖的空间；stove 是炉具，可指烹饪炉灶，也可指封闭式取暖炉；furnace 常指工业熔炉或建筑的中央供暖炉。炉灶上做饭用 on the stove；壁炉里生火用 in the fireplace；不能把 furnace 当作普通厨房炉灶。

words.definitionEn: An appliance used for cooking or heating a room.
words.scenario: 常用于做饭或局部取暖

examples.en: Put the pan on the stove.

words.correctUsage: Put the pan on the stove.
words.commonMistakes: fireplace 是壁炉或生火取暖的空间；stove 是炉具，可指烹饪炉灶，也可指封闭式取暖炉；furnace 常指工业熔炉或建筑的中央供暖炉。炉灶上做饭用 on the stove；壁炉里生火用 in the fireplace；不能把 furnace 当作普通厨房炉灶。

words.definitionEn: An enclosed structure producing high heat for industry or building heating.
words.scenario: 常指工业高温处理或建筑供暖设备

examples.en: The metal melted in the furnace.

words.correctUsage: The metal melted in the furnace.
words.commonMistakes: fireplace 是壁炉或生火取暖的空间；stove 是炉具，可指烹饪炉灶，也可指封闭式取暖炉；furnace 常指工业熔炉或建筑的中央供暖炉。炉灶上做饭用 on the stove；壁炉里生火用 in the fireplace；不能把 furnace 当作普通厨房炉灶。

words.definitionEn: Correct and close to the true facts or value.
words.scenario: 与事实或真实数值相符
words.commonMistakes: accurate 侧重正确贴合事实；precise 侧重细节清楚或测量一致。科学测量中的准确度与精密度有专门含义，日常用法则有重叠。

words.definitionEn: Exact, detailed, and clearly expressed or measured.
words.scenario: 日常指准确具体、表达明确；测量语境可指重复结果接近，不应把精密度等同显示小数位数
words.commonMistakes: accurate 侧重正确贴合事实；precise 侧重细节清楚或测量一致。科学测量中的准确度与精密度有专门含义，日常用法则有重叠。

words.definitionEn: To give reasons for a view or disagree with someone verbally.
words.scenario: 既可争吵，也可提出理由支持观点

examples.en: She argues that the plan will work.
examples.zh: 她论证说这个计划能奏效。

words.correctUsage: She argues that the plan will work.
words.commonMistakes: 要表达“论证认为”用 argue that，不要默认翻译成吵架。反对某个结果可用 dispute the result；围绕议题交换理由用 debate；人际口角常用 quarrel。

words.definitionEn: To question whether something is true or valid; a disagreement.
words.scenario: 对事实、权利、结果等提出异议
words.commonMistakes: 要表达“论证认为”用 argue that，不要默认翻译成吵架。反对某个结果可用 dispute the result；围绕议题交换理由用 debate；人际口角常用 quarrel。

words.definitionEn: An angry disagreement, often about a personal matter; to argue angrily.
words.scenario: 较偏人际冲突、口角，常带情绪
words.commonMistakes: 要表达“论证认为”用 argue that，不要默认翻译成吵架。反对某个结果可用 dispute the result；围绕议题交换理由用 debate；人际口角常用 quarrel。

words.definitionEn: To discuss opposing views, often in a structured way.
words.scenario: 围绕议题比较观点、理由，也可指内心权衡
words.commonMistakes: 要表达“论证认为”用 argue that，不要默认翻译成吵架。反对某个结果可用 dispute the result；围绕议题交换理由用 debate；人际口角常用 quarrel。

words.definitionEn: To want something, often something unreal or unlikely; to express a good desire for someone.
words.scenario: 可表达与事实不符的愿望、遗憾；wish to do 较正式

examples.en: I wish I had more time.

words.correctUsage: I wish I had more time.
words.commonMistakes: 希望未来可能实现的事常用 hope；遗憾现在事实常用 wish + 过去式；遗憾过去常用 wish + had done。I wish to speak 是正式的“我想发言”，并不表示不可能。

words.definitionEn: To want something to happen and think it may be possible.
words.scenario: 希望某事发生，通常认为有可能

examples.en: I hope to see you soon.

words.correctUsage: I hope to see you soon.
words.commonMistakes: 希望未来可能实现的事常用 hope；遗憾现在事实常用 wish + 过去式；遗憾过去常用 wish + had done。I wish to speak 是正式的“我想发言”，并不表示不可能。

words.definitionEn: To give and receive things, ideas, or information in return.
words.scenario: 范围广，包括意见、货币、信息和物品
words.commonMistakes: exchange 覆盖意见、货币、礼物等多种交流；swap 更常见于日常互换。exchange/swap A for B 表示拿A换B；与人交换则常用 with。

words.definitionEn: To exchange one thing for another, often directly between two people.
words.scenario: 更口语，常指双方直接交换两件东西或角色
words.commonMistakes: exchange 覆盖意见、货币、礼物等多种交流；swap 更常见于日常互换。exchange/swap A for B 表示拿A换B；与人交换则常用 with。

words.definitionEn: Careful about other people's feelings and needs.
words.scenario: 考虑别人感受，避免造成不便
words.commonMistakes: considerate 侧重顾及别人；thoughtful 既可贴心也可深思。注意 considerate 与 considerable（相当大的）拼写相似，词义却不同。

words.definitionEn: Showing care for others or thinking carefully about something.
words.scenario: 可指贴心行为，也可指认真思考的状态或成果
words.commonMistakes: considerate 侧重顾及别人；thoughtful 既可贴心也可深思。注意 considerate 与 considerable（相当大的）拼写相似，词义却不同。

words.definitionEn: To make something shorter or more concentrated, or change gas into liquid.
words.scenario: 气体变液体，或提炼内容使紧凑

examples.en: Condense the report into one page.

words.correctUsage: Condense the report into one page.
words.commonMistakes: 气体凝结用 condense；压缩文件、气体体积用 compress。缩短文章时两者都可能成立：condense 更突出浓缩要点，compress 更突出压入更短篇幅。

words.definitionEn: To press into less space or reduce the size of data.
words.scenario: 通过压力、编码等减少体积或占用空间

examples.en: Compress the file before sending it.

words.correctUsage: Compress the file before sending it.
words.commonMistakes: 气体凝结用 condense；压缩文件、气体体积用 compress。缩短文章时两者都可能成立：condense 更突出浓缩要点，compress 更突出压入更短篇幅。

words.definitionEn: A reason for a particular action.
words.scenario: 具体行动背后的原因，调查语境常见但未必负面

examples.en: Her motive was to help others.

words.correctUsage: Her motive was to help others.
words.commonMistakes: 问一次行为的具体理由用 motive 很自然；问学习积极性用 motivation 更自然。motivation 也可指行为动机，不能把二者完全割裂。

words.definitionEn: The desire or drive to act, or the reasons behind an action.
words.scenario: 既可指行为原因，也常指行动积极性

examples.en: I lack the motivation to study.

words.correctUsage: I lack the motivation to study.
words.commonMistakes: 问一次行为的具体理由用 motive 很自然；问学习积极性用 motivation 更自然。motivation 也可指行为动机，不能把二者完全割裂。

words.definitionEn: Directly connected to the matter being considered.
words.scenario: 与当前问题、目标或任务有关
words.commonMistakes: “有关联”不保证“切题”。related to 表联系，relevant to 表与当前目标相关；寻找写作论据时更应检查其是否 relevant。

words.meaningZh: adj. 有联系的；有亲属关系的
words.definitionEn: Connected in some way, or belonging to the same family.
words.scenario: 只说明有联系，未必有助于当前问题
words.commonMistakes: “有关联”不保证“切题”。related to 表联系，relevant to 表与当前目标相关；寻找写作论据时更应检查其是否 relevant。

words.definitionEn: To make something happen sooner or act without delay.
words.scenario: 使过程更快，或急忙采取行动；较正式
words.commonMistakes: hasten 与 harry 不是一组可随便互换的同义词。若想表达“赶快”，常见词其实是 hurry；harry 则带有纠缠、反复施压的意味。

words.definitionEn: To repeatedly trouble, pressure, or attack someone.
words.scenario: 反复攻击、逼迫或打扰；不是 hurry 的变体

examples.zh: 记者不断用问题纠缠他。

words.commonMistakes: hasten 与 harry 不是一组可随便互换的同义词。若想表达“赶快”，常见词其实是 hurry；harry 则带有纠缠、反复施压的意味。

words.definitionEn: Because of a particular cause or reason.
words.scenario: 后接名词性成分，交代原因；较正式

examples.en: The match stopped owing to rain.

words.correctUsage: The match stopped owing to rain.
words.commonMistakes: 原因义后面接名词或动名词，不直接接完整句子；完整原因从句可用 because。be due to arrive 中 to 是不定式标记，意思是预计到达，不是“因为到达”。

words.definitionEn: Because of or caused by something.
words.scenario: 现代英语中原因义与 owing to 广泛重叠

examples.en: The delay was due to a fault.

words.correctUsage: The delay was due to a fault.
words.commonMistakes: 原因义后面接名词或动名词，不直接接完整句子；完整原因从句可用 because。be due to arrive 中 to 是不定式标记，意思是预计到达，不是“因为到达”。

words.definitionEn: To repeat someone's exact words or state a price.
words.scenario: 强调复现原文，也可指提供价格

examples.en: She quoted a line from the poem.

words.correctUsage: She quoted a line from the poem.
words.commonMistakes: 直接复制原话通常是 quote；交代依据来源通常是 cite。可以 cite 一项研究而完全不 quote 其原句，也可以同时做这两件事。

words.definitionEn: To mention a source, example, or fact as support.
words.scenario: 指出来源、例证或理由，不必逐字复制
words.commonMistakes: 直接复制原话通常是 quote；交代依据来源通常是 cite。可以 cite 一项研究而完全不 quote 其原句，也可以同时做这两件事。

words.definitionEn: To assign resources to a particular person or purpose.
words.scenario: 按计划决定资源归属或用途

examples.en: We allocated an hour to discussion.
examples.zh: 我们安排了一小时讨论。

words.correctUsage: We allocated an hour to discussion.
words.commonMistakes: 预算怎么分、时间留给谁，常用 allocate；东西具体发到各处，常用 distribute。分配可能先于分发，但两词也会在资源分配语境中重叠。

words.definitionEn: To give things out or spread them over an area.
words.scenario: 把东西送到各处，或呈某种空间分布

examples.en: They distributed food to the villagers.

words.correctUsage: They distributed food to the villagers.

words.commonMistakes: 日常推想常用 suppose；证据不足而推测常用 speculate。be supposed to do 常表示应该或按安排做，与 speculate 的猜测义不能直接互换。

words.meaningZh: n./v. 偏见；使有偏见；损害
words.definitionEn: An unfair judgment made without sufficient knowledge; to bias or harm.
words.scenario: 常指未充分了解便形成的态度，也可作动词
words.commonMistakes: 这组原词词性不平行：prejudice 常是名词，discriminate 是动词。若比较两个名词，应用 prejudice 与 discrimination；前者偏态度，后者歧视义偏行为。

words.commonMistakes: 这组原词词性不平行：prejudice 常是名词，discriminate 是动词。若比较两个名词，应用 prejudice 与 discrimination；前者偏态度，后者歧视义偏行为。

words.meaningZh: n./v. 夹子；短片；夹住；剪；击打或擦撞
words.definitionEn: A fastener or short extract; to fasten, cut, or hit something briefly, often at an edge.

examples.en: The car clipped the kerb as it turned.
examples.zh: 汽车转弯时擦撞了路缘。

examples.en: Clip the badge to your shirt.

words.correctUsage: The car clipped the kerb as it turned.
words.commonMistakes: 比较碰撞义时，clip 常指短促击打或擦撞边缘，如 The car clipped the kerb；bump 指碰到、撞上，常但不一定力度较轻，如 I bumped into the table。clip 并不一定是故意动作；bump 也不一定只限于意外。bump into someone 还可表示偶遇。clip 的夹子、短片、夹住和剪等义需另按语境理解。

words.definitionEn: A small raised area or a light collision; to hit something accidentally.
words.scenario: 常指不太猛烈的撞击或表面不平
words.commonMistakes: 比较碰撞义时，clip 常指短促击打或擦撞边缘，如 The car clipped the kerb；bump 指碰到、撞上，常但不一定力度较轻，如 I bumped into the table。clip 并不一定是故意动作；bump 也不一定只限于意外。bump into someone 还可表示偶遇。clip 的夹子、短片、夹住和剪等义需另按语境理解。

words.scenario: 较正式，具体类别靠修饰语判断
words.commonMistakes: 船舶语境中，vessel 指整艘船，cabin 指船内供人居住或使用的舱室：a cabin on a vessel。它们是整体与内部空间的区别，不是两种船的名称。cabin 也可指飞机客舱或小木屋；vessel 还可指容器及血管，如 a blood vessel。此组由原第77组拆出，词条与例句保留。

words.scenario: 指小屋或运输工具中的封闭空间

words.correctUsage: We stayed in a cabin by the lake.
words.commonMistakes: 船舶语境中，vessel 指整艘船，cabin 指船内供人居住或使用的舱室：a cabin on a vessel。它们是整体与内部空间的区别，不是两种船的名称。cabin 也可指飞机客舱或小木屋；vessel 还可指容器及血管，如 a blood vessel。此组由原第77组拆出，词条与例句保留。

words.definitionEn: Thin and graceful; also small or limited in amount.
words.scenario: 强调细而长，常带优雅感；也可形容微小机会

words.meaningZh: adj./v. 苗条的；微小的；减肥
words.definitionEn: Attractively thin; also small in probability; to lose weight.
words.scenario: 身材义常是褒义，不一定强调高或长
words.commonMistakes: slender 强调细长修长，slim 强调苗条匀称，skinny 常有很瘦的评价。slim/slender chance 都可表示机会渺茫，不能都照身材义理解。

words.definitionEn: Very thin, often in a way considered unattractive or unhealthy.

words.commonMistakes: slender 强调细长修长，slim 强调苗条匀称，skinny 常有很瘦的评价。slim/slender chance 都可表示机会渺茫，不能都照身材义理解。

words.definitionEn: The distance or time between two limits; to extend across them.
words.scenario: 强调两端之间的长度或持续时间

examples.zh: 她的职业生涯长达四十年。

words.commonMistakes: span 常看两端跨度，range 常看上下限或种类。a price range 指价格范围，a time span 指时间跨度；两者有交叉但搭配不同。

words.definitionEn: The limits, variety, or extent of something; to vary between limits.
words.scenario: 强调上下限、覆盖范围或可选种类

examples.en: The shop sells a wide range of books.
examples.zh: 这家店出售种类繁多的书。

words.correctUsage: The shop sells a wide range of books.
words.commonMistakes: span 常看两端跨度，range 常看上下限或种类。a price range 指价格范围，a time span 指时间跨度；两者有交叉但搭配不同。

words.meaningZh: n./v. 选票；投票；进行投票
words.definitionEn: A voting paper or a voting process, usually secret; to hold a vote.
words.scenario: 常强调正式表决的方式、程序或一轮投票

examples.zh: 这项决定是投票作出的。

words.correctUsage: The decision was made by ballot.
words.commonMistakes: vote 既可指投票行为也可数票；ballot 常突出选票或投票程序。by secret ballot 表示无记名投票，不意味着只能使用纸张。

words.definitionEn: A formal expression of choice; to express that choice in a decision.
words.scenario: 可以指行为、票数、表决或投票权
words.commonMistakes: vote 既可指投票行为也可数票；ballot 常突出选票或投票程序。by secret ballot 表示无记名投票，不意味着只能使用纸张。

words.definitionEn: An aim or intention; as an adjective, focused or firmly determined.
words.scenario: 名词较正式；形容词表示一心投入

examples.en: She is intent on finishing today.

words.correctUsage: She is intent on finishing today.
words.commonMistakes: 打算做什么常用 intention；更正式的意图常用 intent；为什么做或某物有何用途用 purpose。intent on 中 on 是介词，后接名词或动名词。 intent 与 intention 的名词义大幅重叠；不能把 intent 固定解释为动机、intention 固定解释为计划。motive 更直接回答促使行动的原因，而 intent 常说明意图实现什么。

words.definitionEn: Something you plan or mean to do.
words.scenario: 常用于某人计划做或不做某事

examples.en: I have no intention of leaving.

words.correctUsage: I have no intention of leaving.
words.commonMistakes: 打算做什么常用 intention；更正式的意图常用 intent；为什么做或某物有何用途用 purpose。intent on 中 on 是介词，后接名词或动名词。 intent 与 intention 的名词义大幅重叠；不能把 intent 固定解释为动机、intention 固定解释为计划。motive 更直接回答促使行动的原因，而 intent 常说明意图实现什么。

words.definitionEn: The reason something is done or the use it is designed for.
words.scenario: 回答为什么做、用来干什么或有什么意义

examples.en: What is the purpose of this button?

words.correctUsage: What is the purpose of this button?

words.definitionEn: The top of a mountain or a meeting of leaders.
words.scenario: 山的最高点，或领导人的高级别会议

examples.zh: 领导人出席了一场峰会。

words.commonMistakes: 山顶义 summit/peak 可重叠；领导人峰会用 summit；需求或销量峰值用 peak。peak 可作动词：Sales peaked，summit 通常不这样表达数值达到峰值。

words.meaningZh: n./v./adj. 山峰；峰值；达到顶峰的
words.definitionEn: A mountain top or highest level; to reach the highest point.
words.scenario: 实体峰顶或抽象数值、水平的最高点
words.commonMistakes: 山顶义 summit/peak 可重叠；领导人峰会用 summit；需求或销量峰值用 peak。peak 可作动词：Sales peaked，summit 通常不这样表达数值达到峰值。

words.definitionEn: To fail to give necessary care or attention; such a failure.
words.scenario: 未给予应有的注意或照顾，可长期也可一次

examples.zh: 花园因疏于照料而荒废。

words.commonMistakes: neglect 可为未照料、未注意或未尽责，不一定故意；an oversight 常是无意遗漏。监督义 oversight 通常不可数，需结合 government/regulatory 等上下文判断。

words.definitionEn: An accidental omission or mistake; also supervision.
words.scenario: an oversight 指无意遗漏；监督义通常不可数
words.commonMistakes: neglect 可为未照料、未注意或未尽责，不一定故意；an oversight 常是无意遗漏。监督义 oversight 通常不可数，需结合 government/regulatory 等上下文判断。

words.definitionEn: To connect ideas or people; a colleague; sometimes a lower-ranking title.
words.scenario: 职称表示专业级别或关联身份，不能统一排职级
words.commonMistakes: 职称按具体机构正式名称理解，associate、vice-、deputy 不能排成普遍通用的职级高低表。associate 还可作联系的动词，vice 单独作名词常是恶习。

words.definitionEn: In job titles, a prefix indicating a deputy or second-in-command.
words.scenario: 常出现在副职称中；单独名词 vice 另有恶习等义
words.commonMistakes: 职称按具体机构正式名称理解，associate、vice-、deputy 不能排成普遍通用的职级高低表。associate 还可作联系的动词，vice 单独作名词常是恶习。

words.scenario: 把不同东西放在一起，不要求完全融合
words.commonMistakes: mix 只是混合，blend 常暗示协调或均匀；两者在食物语境有重叠。mix up names 是混淆名字，blend into the crowd 是融入人群。

words.definitionEn: To combine smoothly into a unified mixture.
words.scenario: 常强调均匀、协调、不容易分辨各部分

examples.en: Her voice blended with the music.
examples.zh: 她的声音与音乐融为一体。

words.correctUsage: Her voice blended with the music.
words.commonMistakes: mix 只是混合，blend 常暗示协调或均匀；两者在食物语境有重叠。mix up names 是混淆名字，blend into the crowd 是融入人群。

words.meaningZh: v. 构成；算作；正式建立

words.scenario: 说明组成关系，或某行为性质属于什么

words.correctUsage: They constructed a model of the system.

words.meaningZh: adj./过去分词：有义务的；感激的

examples.en: I'm much obliged for your help.

words.definitionEn: Bound by a duty, promise, or rule to do something.

words.commonMistakes: 义务义两者大多可互换，不要硬分成道德义务与法律义务。much obliged 是表达感谢的固定用法，一般不用 much obligated 替换。

words.definitionEn: To begin using an idea or method, or legally take a child into your family.
words.scenario: 接受方法、政策或态度，也可收养孩子
words.commonMistakes: adapt 调整以适应；adopt 接受采用或收养。adapt to 的 to 为介词，后接名词或动名词；adopt a method 中不需要 to。

words.definitionEn: Relating to the economy or the study of economics.
words.scenario: 常说明与经济活动有关，而非一定省钱

examples.zh: 这个国家面临经济问题。

words.commonMistakes: 经济政策用 economic，节省运行成本用 economical。economic 在部分语境也有合算义，所以不是所有省钱表达都只能用 economical；先记常见搭配。

words.meaningZh: adj. 节约的；经济实惠的
words.definitionEn: Using money, fuel, or other resources carefully and without waste.
words.scenario: 强调使用金钱、燃料、时间等较节省

examples.en: This car is economical to run.

words.correctUsage: This car is economical to run.
words.commonMistakes: 经济政策用 economic，节省运行成本用 economical。economic 在部分语境也有合算义，所以不是所有省钱表达都只能用 economical；先记常见搭配。

words.definitionEn: To make certain that something happens or is true.
words.scenario: 采取行动使结果可靠地发生

examples.en: Check the lock to ensure safety.

words.correctUsage: Check the lock to ensure safety.
words.commonMistakes: 确保结果常用 ensure；让人放心常用 assure sb；投保常用 insure。美式 insure 有时也能表示确保，但不要据此把所有句型互换。

words.definitionEn: To tell someone confidently that something is true so they feel less worried.
words.scenario: 常对某人作保证，直接宾语通常是人

examples.en: I assured him that I would help.

words.correctUsage: I assured him that I would help.
words.commonMistakes: 确保结果常用 ensure；让人放心常用 assure sb；投保常用 insure。美式 insure 有时也能表示确保，但不要据此把所有句型互换。

words.definitionEn: To arrange or provide financial protection against specified risks.
words.scenario: 常用于保险，也有确保义，尤其美式用法

examples.en: The house is insured against fire.

words.correctUsage: The house is insured against fire.
words.commonMistakes: 确保结果常用 ensure；让人放心常用 assure sb；投保常用 insure。美式 insure 有时也能表示确保，但不要据此把所有句型互换。

words.definitionEn: Achieving a result with little wasted time, energy, or resources.
words.scenario: 用较少的资源、时间或精力完成工作

examples.en: The new system is more efficient.

words.correctUsage: The new system is more efficient.
words.commonMistakes: efficient 看资源利用，effective 看是否奏效。方法可以有效但低效，也可能执行高效却未实现目标；两词关注不同评价维度。

words.definitionEn: Producing the intended result; also officially in force.
words.scenario: 达到预期效果，或正式开始适用

examples.en: The method is effective but slow.

words.correctUsage: The method is effective but slow.
words.commonMistakes: efficient 看资源利用，effective 看是否奏效。方法可以有效但低效，也可能执行高效却未实现目标；两词关注不同评价维度。

words.definitionEn: To willingly take, agree to, or recognize something.
words.scenario: 态度上同意接纳，不只是到手
words.commonMistakes: 收到邀请用 receive，决定应邀用 accept。receive 不表示一定自愿接受；accept responsibility 又是承担责任，不能简单译为收到责任。

words.definitionEn: To get something that is sent, given, or provided.
words.scenario: 东西、信息、待遇等到达，不必表示同意
words.commonMistakes: 收到邀请用 receive，决定应邀用 accept。receive 不表示一定自愿接受；accept responsibility 又是承担责任，不能简单译为收到责任。

words.definitionEn: Expected to happen or probably true.
words.scenario: 常用于预测人或事物会怎样
words.commonMistakes: possible 只说有可能，likely/probable 通常倾向很可能，但不能固定成百分比。说 He is likely to come；不说 He is possible/probable to come。

words.definitionEn: Able to happen or be done, without saying it is likely.
words.scenario: 未被排除，未必概率很大

examples.en: It is possible that he forgot.

words.correctUsage: It is possible that he forgot.
words.commonMistakes: possible 只说有可能，likely/probable 通常倾向很可能，但不能固定成百分比。说 He is likely to come；不说 He is possible/probable to come。

words.definitionEn: Likely to happen or be true.
words.scenario: 比仅仅 possible 更倾向会发生，较正式

examples.en: Rain is the probable cause of the delay.
examples.zh: 雨很可能是延误的原因。

words.correctUsage: Rain is the probable cause of the delay.
words.commonMistakes: possible 只说有可能，likely/probable 通常倾向很可能，但不能固定成百分比。说 He is likely to come；不说 He is possible/probable to come。

words.meaningZh: adj. 有条理的；有组织的
words.definitionEn: Able to plan things neatly and effectively; also arranged in a structured way.
words.scenario: 形容人做事有条理，或活动经过安排；也可作 organize 的过去式/过去分词

examples.en: She is organized and always meets deadlines.
examples.zh: 她做事有条理，总能按时完成任务。

words.correctUsage: She is organized and always meets deadlines.
words.commonMistakes: 形容“你很有条理”用 You are organized；说“组织协调能力”用 organizational skills。organized 是对状态或特点的评价，organizational 是“与组织管理有关”的关系形容词。organized activities 是有组织的活动；organizational changes 是组织层面的变动。

words.meaningZh: adj. 组织的；组织管理方面的
words.definitionEn: Relating to how an organization or activity is structured, managed, or coordinated.
words.scenario: 说明与组织结构、管理或协调能力有关，不直接表示一个人有条理

examples.en: The job requires strong organizational skills.
examples.zh: 这份工作要求很强的组织协调能力。

words.correctUsage: The job requires strong organizational skills.
words.commonMistakes: 形容“你很有条理”用 You are organized；说“组织协调能力”用 organizational skills。organized 是对状态或特点的评价，organizational 是“与组织管理有关”的关系形容词。organized activities 是有组织的活动；organizational changes 是组织层面的变动。

words.definitionEn: To give someone a task or role, or designate something for a particular use.
words.scenario: 把具体任务、角色或资源交给某人，也可给事物赋值或归类

examples.en: The teacher assigned each student a topic.
examples.zh: 老师给每名学生分配了一个题目。

words.correctUsage: The teacher assigned each student a topic.
words.commonMistakes: assign 回答“把什么交给谁”，arrange 回答“怎么安排好”。可以先 assign tasks to team members，再 arrange a meeting。安排某人做事常用 arrange for sb to do，不能机械套成 arrange sb to do。原网站的 appoint / arrange 仍保留，appoint 侧重正式任命。

words.definitionEn: Something owned, especially land or buildings; also a characteristic of a thing.
words.scenario: 所有物的总称；也指房地产或事物的特性，强调归属或性质
words.commonMistakes: 同一栋房子可以是你的 property，也可以是你的 asset：前者强调所有权或房产类别，后者强调经济价值。property 作财产总称通常不可数，但 a property 可指一处房产；properties 也可指性质。asset 可数，常用复数 assets；名词 property 没有“团队优势”这个常见用法。

words.meaningZh: n. 资产；有价值的人或事物
words.definitionEn: Something valuable or useful, especially a resource with economic value.
words.scenario: 强调具有经济价值、能带来益处；可包括现金、专利、技能等

examples.en: Her language skills are an asset to the team.
examples.zh: 她的语言能力是团队的一大优势。

words.correctUsage: Her language skills are an asset to the team.
words.commonMistakes: 同一栋房子可以是你的 property，也可以是你的 asset：前者强调所有权或房产类别，后者强调经济价值。property 作财产总称通常不可数，但 a property 可指一处房产；properties 也可指性质。asset 可数，常用复数 assets；名词 property 没有“团队优势”这个常见用法。

words.definitionEn: A competition; as a verb, to compete for something or formally challenge a claim or decision.
words.scenario: 名词常指一项评选或比赛；动词常指争夺席位，或正式质疑决定

examples.en: They contested the result of the election.
examples.zh: 他们对选举结果提出了异议。

words.correctUsage: They contested the result of the election.
words.commonMistakes: “参加比赛”通常说 enter a contest 或 compete in a contest。compete 常接 in、for、with/against；contest 作动词可直接接 election、seat、decision 等。contest a decision 是质疑决定，不是参加决定；contest an election 可指参与竞选，具体含义要看宾语和语境。

words.definitionEn: To try to win or succeed against others in an event, activity, or market.
words.scenario: 通常不及物，强调与别人竞争的行为

examples.zh: 运动员为争夺奖牌而比赛。

words.commonMistakes: “参加比赛”通常说 enter a contest 或 compete in a contest。compete 常接 in、for、with/against；contest 作动词可直接接 election、seat、decision 等。contest a decision 是质疑决定，不是参加决定；contest an election 可指参与竞选，具体含义要看宾语和语境。

words.definitionEn: Unwanted material to be thrown away; also worthless content; to discard or criticize harshly.
words.scenario: 美式常用垃圾总称，也指无价值的内容；作动词可指丢弃或严厉批评
words.commonMistakes: trash 与 garbage 在美式日常用法中有大量重叠，不能硬分成“干垃圾”和“湿垃圾”。junk 更突出废旧杂物或低质量东西。三者作这些总称时通常不可数，用 a piece of junk / a bag of garbage。英式英语常用 rubbish；junk food 并非字面上的垃圾。

words.definitionEn: Unwanted or low-value things, especially old objects; to throw them away.
words.scenario: 偏指不需要、质量差或无价值的物品，不一定已经被扔进垃圾桶

examples.en: The garage is full of old junk.
examples.zh: 车库里堆满了废旧杂物。

words.correctUsage: The garage is full of old junk.
words.commonMistakes: trash 与 garbage 在美式日常用法中有大量重叠，不能硬分成“干垃圾”和“湿垃圾”。junk 更突出废旧杂物或低质量东西。三者作这些总称时通常不可数，用 a piece of junk / a bag of garbage。英式英语常用 rubbish；junk food 并非字面上的垃圾。

words.definitionEn: Waste, often household or food waste; also ideas or statements considered worthless.
words.scenario: 美式常指生活垃圾，尤其常见于厨余语境，也能泛指垃圾或胡说

examples.en: Put the food scraps in the garbage.
examples.zh: 把食物残渣扔进垃圾里。

words.correctUsage: Put the food scraps in the garbage.
words.commonMistakes: trash 与 garbage 在美式日常用法中有大量重叠，不能硬分成“干垃圾”和“湿垃圾”。junk 更突出废旧杂物或低质量东西。三者作这些总称时通常不可数，用 a piece of junk / a bag of garbage。英式英语常用 rubbish；junk food 并非字面上的垃圾。

words.meaningZh: n./v. 压力；拉伤；品系；用力；过滤
words.definitionEn: Pressure or excessive effort; an injury from overstretching; a biological variety; to exert effort or filter liquid.
words.scenario: 多义词：精神或身体的负担、肌肉拉伤、生物品系；动词可指使劲或滤去液体中的固体

examples.en: She strained to hear the quiet voice.
examples.zh: 她竭力想听清那个轻轻的声音。

words.correctUsage: She strained to hear the quiet voice.
words.commonMistakes: strain 不能只记为“拉伤”：under strain 表示承受压力，a muscle strain 是肌肉或肌腱拉伤，a strain of bacteria 是细菌菌株。strain to do 表示费力做，strain one's eyes 是过度用眼，strain the soup 是过滤汤。sprain 通常指韧带扭伤；不要把它与 strain 的损伤义混为一谈。

words.meaningZh: v. 续期；重新开始；恢复
words.definitionEn: To extend a period of validity, start again, or restore strength or freshness.
words.scenario: 让期限延长或让某种状态再次出现，不一定涉及实体改造

examples.en: I need to renew my library membership.
examples.zh: 我需要续办图书馆会员资格。

words.correctUsage: I need to renew my library membership.
words.commonMistakes: 续订会员、续期证件用 renew；翻新房屋用 renovate。renew hope / renew efforts 表示重新燃起希望或再次努力。renovate 通常针对旧建筑和室内空间，不用来表达“续费会员”。名词分别是 renewal 和 renovation。

words.definitionEn: To repair and improve an old building or room.
words.scenario: 主要修复、改善旧建筑或房间，让它重新处于良好状态
words.commonMistakes: 续订会员、续期证件用 renew；翻新房屋用 renovate。renew hope / renew efforts 表示重新燃起希望或再次努力。renovate 通常针对旧建筑和室内空间，不用来表达“续费会员”。名词分别是 renewal 和 renovation。

words.definitionEn: To wake someone, make them active, or stir a strong feeling.
words.scenario: 从睡眠、不活跃状态中唤起，也常指激起情绪或行动，较有力度

examples.en: The speech roused the audience to action.
examples.zh: 演讲激发了听众采取行动。

words.correctUsage: The speech roused the audience to action.
words.commonMistakes: “我醒着”说 I am awake；“我醒了”说 I woke up；“他叫醒我”说 He woke me up。rouse 常带从沉睡或消极状态中唤起的意味，也能激起兴趣或行动。awake 作形容词通常放在 be、stay、keep 等后面；放在名词前通常不自然，可说 a child who is awake。作动词时常说 awake from sleep，不通常说 awake up。

words.definitionEn: To stop sleeping or cause someone to stop sleeping.
words.scenario: 最常见的日常动词，可及物或不及物，常与 up 连用

examples.en: Please wake me up at seven.

words.correctUsage: Please wake me up at seven.
words.commonMistakes: “我醒着”说 I am awake；“我醒了”说 I woke up；“他叫醒我”说 He woke me up。rouse 常带从沉睡或消极状态中唤起的意味，也能激起兴趣或行动。awake 作形容词通常放在 be、stay、keep 等后面；放在名词前通常不自然，可说 a child who is awake。作动词时常说 awake from sleep，不通常说 awake up。

words.definitionEn: Not asleep; as a verb, to stop sleeping or become aware.
words.scenario: 形容词用法常见，作表语表示没有睡着；动词较正式，常不用 up

examples.en: I was still awake at midnight.

words.correctUsage: I was still awake at midnight.
words.commonMistakes: “我醒着”说 I am awake；“我醒了”说 I woke up；“他叫醒我”说 He woke me up。rouse 常带从沉睡或消极状态中唤起的意味，也能激起兴趣或行动。awake 作形容词通常放在 be、stay、keep 等后面；放在名词前通常不自然，可说 a child who is awake。作动词时常说 awake from sleep，不通常说 awake up。

words.definitionEn: To realize in advance that a future event or problem may occur.
words.scenario: 根据情况预先意识到未来可能发生的事，不强调具体量化方法

examples.en: We did not foresee these delays.
examples.zh: 我们没有预见到这些延误。

words.correctUsage: We did not foresee these delays.
words.commonMistakes: predict 是通用的预测、预言；forecast 常用于天气、经济、销量等预报，往往依据数据；foresee 强调提前意识到或预见某种情况。区别是常见语境与表达重点，不是“能否预测数字”的语法禁令。温度预报常说 forecast/predict the temperature；foresee problems/consequences 更典型。foresee–foresaw–foreseen；forecast 的过去式和过去分词可用 forecast 或 forecasted。

words.definitionEn: To estimate a future condition or trend, often using available data; the estimate itself.
words.scenario: 常依据数据或模型预测天气、经济等趋势及数值
words.commonMistakes: predict 是通用的预测、预言；forecast 常用于天气、经济、销量等预报，往往依据数据；foresee 强调提前意识到或预见某种情况。区别是常见语境与表达重点，不是“能否预测数字”的语法禁令。温度预报常说 forecast/predict the temperature；foresee problems/consequences 更典型。foresee–foresaw–foreseen；forecast 的过去式和过去分词可用 forecast 或 forecasted。

words.definitionEn: To say what you think will happen in the future.
words.scenario: 最通用，可根据证据、经验或直觉说未来会怎样

examples.zh: 专家预测明天会有更多降雨。

words.commonMistakes: predict 是通用的预测、预言；forecast 常用于天气、经济、销量等预报，往往依据数据；foresee 强调提前意识到或预见某种情况。区别是常见语境与表达重点，不是“能否预测数字”的语法禁令。温度预报常说 forecast/predict the temperature；foresee problems/consequences 更典型。foresee–foresaw–foreseen；forecast 的过去式和过去分词可用 forecast 或 forecasted。

words.definitionEn: To work out a result by following mathematical steps, especially with a computer.
words.scenario: 偏正式或技术语境，按步骤或算法算出结果，常用于计算机处理

examples.en: The software computes the average automatically.
examples.zh: 软件会自动计算平均值。

words.correctUsage: The software computes the average automatically.
words.commonMistakes: calculate 是通用的计算，compute 多用于技术、数学或机器按规则运算。日常算账用 calculate the bill 自然；软件算平均值可用 compute the average。两者在数学语境可互换，但 compute 不等于“电脑”这个名词。

words.definitionEn: To find a number or amount by using mathematics or careful reasoning.
words.scenario: 通用词，强调用数字或推理求出结果，也可指有意筹划

examples.en: Can you calculate the total cost?

words.correctUsage: Can you calculate the total cost?
words.commonMistakes: calculate 是通用的计算，compute 多用于技术、数学或机器按规则运算。日常算账用 calculate the bill 自然；软件算平均值可用 compute the average。两者在数学语境可互换，但 compute 不等于“电脑”这个名词。

words.meaningZh: adj. 持续不减的；毫不松懈的
words.definitionEn: Continuing with great intensity or determination without easing or stopping.
words.scenario: 强调压力、努力或追求持续不止；既可褒义也可贬义，不必含残忍意味
words.commonMistakes: brutal 强调残暴、强烈或严酷；cruel 强调造成痛苦或不顾他人痛苦；relentless 强调持续、不放松。a brutal attack 是残暴袭击，a cruel joke 是伤人的玩笑，relentless effort 是不懈努力。relentless 可赞扬坚持，不能一概译为“残忍”；relentless attacks 则可带负面意义。 和第36组相比，persistent 强调持续或反复，tenacious 强调紧抓不放，relentless 更强调强度不减。ruthless 偏为达目的不顾他人，merciless 偏不留情，harsh 偏严厉或刺耳；这些也不是严格的强弱等级。
words.source: recent conversation topics; original explanatory notes

words.meaningZh: v./n. 跳水；潜水；俯冲；骤降
words.definitionEn: To enter water, swim underwater, move down quickly, or fall sharply in value.
words.scenario: 可指跳入水中、潜水、俯冲、迅速投入；也可描述价格暴跌，不保证动作始终受控
words.commonMistakes: 跳水或潜水常用 dive；plunge 强调突然、猛烈地进入或下降，也可有意进行。两词都能描述价格急跌：Share prices dived/plunged. 不可把 dive 限定为受控运动，也不能把 plunge 限定为意外失控。plunge a room into darkness 是使房间突然陷入黑暗；dive into a task 是迅速投入任务。dive–dived–dived；美式过去式也常用 dove，过去分词通常仍用 dived。
words.source: recent conversation topics; original explanatory notes

words.definitionEn: To move or fall suddenly and forcefully into something, or decrease sharply.
words.scenario: 强调突然、猛烈地进入或下落；不要求有技巧或头朝下

examples.en: The room was plunged into darkness.

words.correctUsage: The room was plunged into darkness.
words.commonMistakes: 跳水或潜水常用 dive；plunge 强调突然、猛烈地进入或下降，也可有意进行。两词都能描述价格急跌：Share prices dived/plunged. 不可把 dive 限定为受控运动，也不能把 plunge 限定为意外失控。plunge a room into darkness 是使房间突然陷入黑暗；dive into a task 是迅速投入任务。dive–dived–dived；美式过去式也常用 dove，过去分词通常仍用 dived。
words.source: recent conversation topics; original explanatory notes

words.definitionEn: A large community sharing history or identity; also a country considered as a political community.
words.scenario: 突出共享历史、文化或身份的人群；也可指作为政治共同体的国家

examples.en: The whole nation celebrated the victory.

words.correctUsage: The whole nation celebrated the victory.
words.commonMistakes: nation 与 country 在许多“国家”语境中重叠。nation 常突出人民的共同身份、历史或政治共同体；country 常突出领土、政府和地理实体。一个 nation 不一定对应一个独立 country；不要把 nation 简化为只能指民族。the country 还可表示乡村，in the country 不能直接换成 in the nation。 country 并非在所有名称中都意味着独立主权国家，例如 Scotland 常称为 a country，属于 the United Kingdom。共同语言或血缘不是 nation 在所有用法中的必要条件。

words.definitionEn: Close to the actual value but not exact; as a verb, to estimate or come close to something.
words.scenario: 形容词修饰名词，动词表示接近或估算；不是 approximately 的副词替代形式
words.commonMistakes: approximately 与 roughly 作“大约”时常可互换，正式程度不同不等于精确程度固定不同。approximate 是形容词或动词：an approximate number；approximately 是副词：approximately 50 people，不能说 approximate 50 people 来表示“大约50人”。roughly 另有粗略地、粗暴地的意思。
